set.body:
CODE RED C1 PORTABLE CONTRACT SLICE. This bead begins only after P1R and B0R close. It adds the minimum medium-neutral contract without a decoder, provider, worker, runtime observation or StoryModel migration.

Exact paths:
- core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/core/source.scala
- core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/core/atlas.scala
- core/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/core/SourceBundleSuite.scala
- core/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/core/AtlasSuite.scala
- core/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/coreprobe/SourceConstructionBoundarySuite.scala
- laws/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/laws/SourceLaws.scala
- laws/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/laws/SourceLawsSuite.scala

The contract must implement the ADR 0007 C1 vocabulary already approved: content-addressed SourceBundle and immutable stream manifests; path-dependent PresentationAxis and typed coordinates or interval sets; nonempty heterogeneous EvidenceSupport with no generic mixed-axis ordering or hull; typed boundary populations; checked NarrativeSourceAtlas; and SurfaceAtlas conformance that preserves every text invariant and constructor.

Required refusals and controls: foreign stream, bundle or axis identity; invented edition axis; empty support; invalid or non-finite extent; independently present or missing PTS and DTS; present PTS less than DTS without repair; pure exact rational rescaling and refused inexact or overflow conversion; fixture-scoped operation-derived classification including INT64_MIN; runtime-observation promotion from caller data; support anchor outside bundle; AudioSpan absent versus nonempty versus legacy empty; text SpanSet behavior unchanged. Joined-claim types must be final non-case classes with smart construction and compile-refuse apply, copy, companion fromProduct and Mirror.ProductOf.fromProduct, each with a same-mechanism positive control.

Gate: bash tools/reference-scope.sh from exact base and candidate; emitted JVM, JS and Native core and laws tasks; compileAll; scalafmtCheckAll; property and construction probes; no JVM API or new dependency in portable sources; independent type-discipline and scientific source review. No StoryModel, document compiler, aligner, codec or Sherlock adapter edit in this slice.
set.title: C1 portable film source contracts and SurfaceAtlas conformance
